title: A refresh closes a changed fact with an end date and adds the new one, instead of rewriting it
goal: When the fact diff finds a fact's passage changed so the fact no longer holds, /kb-refresh ends the old line's validity window at the source's change date (or the commit for a CODE fact) and adds the new fact with a window starting there, both citing their sources; doc2query rows follow the new line; a pack with no as-of shows the new fact as current, and an as-of before the change shows the old one.
